notes: Iteration 1 ships infrastructure only. The 3 pilot evals exercise UC-1 (pre-trivial-coverage-gap) and UC-2 (post-small-diff-clean, post-large-diff-mixed) per spec §12.3 lines 971-981. The 15 promotion evals exercise the §14.5.2 9-condition strict gate across all branches per spec §14.5.7 lines 1343-1363. The 2 falsifier entries reference SKELETON cases (status: skeleton-pending-iteration-3-fixture per W-A8 spec-panel fix); the runtime `convergence_score < 0.75 OR verdict == regression_present` assertion is layered in iteration-3 follow-up when the placeholder fixture content is authored. Pilot eval case fixtures (cases/<name>/input/*, expected.yaml) are STUBS in v1.0 — see Steps 5.6-5.8 in TASK-RF-20260527-043715-sc-reflect-rebuild. Promotion fixture YAMLs are STUBS in v1.0 — see Steps 5.10-5.24. All assertion types referenced here are defined in grader.py (10 new types per refs/grader-extensions.md + 8 baseline types inherited from sc-brainstorm).

evals.name: pre-trivial-coverage-gap
evals.description: 8-requirement spec with tasklist missing 2/8 requirements → expected coverage_pct=0.75, missing_requirements=[R-007, R-008], tier_reached=1.

assertions.text: REPORT identifies the missing R-007 / R-008 requirements

evals.name: post-small-diff-clean
evals.description: 3-file clean diff with no deviations → expected deviations=[], tier_reached=1, regression_recall=1.0.

assertions.text: Tier 1 reached on a clean small diff
No drift/regression deviations falsely emitted on a clean diff

evals.name: post-large-diff-mixed
evals.description: 15-file diff with mixed deviation classes (1 regression + 2 drift + 1 necessary + 1 authorized) → expected tier_reached=3 (regression triggers unconditional Tier 3 per §10.4) and per-task verdict shape.

assertions.text: Deviation ledger contains a regression class entry
Tier 3 reached because a regression deviation was found (§10.4)
All file:line citations in REPORT.md resolve against the fixture input/

evals.name: promotion-task-strict-pass
evals.description: All 9 gate conditions pass → action: moved.

evals.name: promotion-blocked-by-drift
evals.description: 1 drift deviation present → action: rejected (drift fails the §14.5.2 gate).

assertions.text: promotion-log identifies no_drift_no_regression as the failing condition (cond 4 — §14.5.2/§14.5.6)

evals.name: promotion-blocked-by-frontmatter-missing
evals.description: Frontmatter `status` field absent → frontmatter_present: fail.

assertions.text: promotion-log identifies frontmatter_present as the failing condition

evals.name: promotion-blocked-by-frontmatter-mismatch
evals.description: reflect says status=done but frontmatter says status=in-progress → frontmatter_status_matches: fail.

assertions.text: promotion-log identifies frontmatter_status_matches as the failing condition

evals.name: promotion-blocked-by-grounding-gaps-empty-list
evals.description: Grounding-gaps list is empty (both empty-list AND missing-list are treated as 'empty' per §14.5.2 canonical definition) → grounding_gaps_resolved: fail.

assertions.text: promotion-log identifies no_grounding_gaps as the failing condition (cond 6b — §14.5.2/§14.5.6)

evals.name: promotion-blocked-by-null-convergence
evals.description: T2 reached + convergence=null (per spec §8 null-convergence handling) → adversarial_result_present: fail.

assertions.text: promotion-log identifies adversarial_result_present as the failing condition

evals.name: promotion-citation-revalidation-after-remediation
evals.description: Wave 6 task-builder remediation mutated a cited file → step 7.2 recomputes citations_dropped against the post-remediation tree; if revalidation passes, action: moved.

assertions.text: promotion-log records action: moved after successful citation revalidation

evals.name: promotion-sprint-release-pass
evals.description: sprint-release adapter exercised: source .dev/releases/current/<release>/ → destination .dev/releases/complete/<release>/. Parent destination directory auto-created.

assertions.text: promotion-log records the sprint-release adapter was selected

evals.name: promotion-collision-non-identical
evals.description: Destination already exists with NON-identical content → action: rejected; diff captured per §14.5.5 7-row collision-rules table.

assertions.text: promotion-log records action: rejected on collision

evals.name: promotion-collision-identical
evals.description: Destination already exists with IDENTICAL content → idempotent already-promoted return; no mutation, no error.

evals.name: promotion-no-promote-flag
evals.description: --no-promote flag set by user → action: skipped; skip_reason: user-flag (per §14.5.4 flag semantics).

evals.name: promotion-promote-anyway-on-partial
evals.description: status: partial + --promote-anyway flag → action: moved (override flag bypasses partial-status gate; all other 7 conditions still apply).

evals.name: promotion-dry-run
evals.description: --promote-dry-run flag → action: dry-run; mv command printed but NO filesystem mutation occurs; promotion-log NOT written.

assertions.text: destination path was NOT mutated during dry-run

evals.name: promotion-cross-fs-crash-recovery
evals.description: Cross-filesystem mv crashed mid-copy + --promote-resume <checkpoint> → action: resumed per §14.5.5 mutation-mechanics 4-state recovery table.

evals.name: promotion-log-pre-write-survives-crash
evals.description: Crash between step 7.4 (promotion-log pre-write) and step 7.6 (commit) → on next invocation, reconciliation reads the pre-written promotion-log and completes per §14.5.6 promotion-log pre-write semantics.

evals.name: T2-converges-on-wrong
evals.use_case: Falsifier-suite (Tier 2 ensemble convergence on wrong answer)
evals.description: Falsifier SKELETON: T2 heterogeneous reviewer ensemble must NOT converge on the wrong answer when fed a fixture with deliberate misclassification. Iteration-3 follow-up promotes status: active and authors the placeholder fixture content at fixtures/spec-with-deliberate-misclassification.md.

assertions.text: Falsifier skeleton T2-converges-on-wrong is present and well-formed

evals.name: T2-judge-class-collision
evals.description: Falsifier SKELETON: reviewer-seating algorithm in refs/reviewer-spec.md MUST refuse to seat a reviewer whose model class matches the calibrator's model class (Khan ICML 2024 weak-judge-strong-debaters disjoint-set rule). Iteration-3 follow-up promotes status: active and authors the full case fixture.

assertions.text: Falsifier skeleton T2-judge-class-collision is present and well-formed
